title: Unnumbered number-of-pumps flow table in Figure 4.10

cell_spans.description: Each header cell is printed on three lines: 'No. OF / PUMPS / IN OPERN' and 'FLOW OF / EACH / PUMP'. Cell text joined with single spaces.

notes: Printed as 'OPERN'; not corrected (OPERATION is presumably intended).

The table is printed inside the Figure 4.10 chart. The same chart carries the curve labels 'H = f (o) THREE PUMPS', 'H = f (o) ONE PUMP', 'H = f (o) TWO PUMPS', 'NPSHn = f (Q)' and 'n = f (Q)', and the discharge axis is marked 'Q3 Q2 Q1'. The lower-case 'o' in 'f (o)' is printed that way, where Q is presumably intended; preserved verbatim, not corrected.
Unnumbered table embedded in a figure; p291-1 is a service locator, not a printed table number.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 200-600 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed page is landscape; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed.
